# FindBookStay.com — Comprehensive System & Marketplace Knowledgebase

FindBookStay (findbookstay.com) is an international unified real estate, hospitality, and sports recreation ecosystem. It bridges the gap between home tenants, travelers seeking verified accommodations, sports enthusiasts seeking tournament-grade sports turf facilities, and property buyers.

## Architectural Philosophy & Brand Identity

- **Color Tokens**:
  - Primary: `#073B35` (Deep British Racing Emerald)
  - Accent: `#10B981` / `#34D399` (Luminous Mint Emerald)
  - Background: `#FFFFFF` / Dark `#0B1210`
  - Surface: `#F8FAF9` / Dark `#111C1A`
- **Typography**: Raleway (Google Fonts), geometric neo-grotesque sans-serif.
- **Platform Guarantee**: Verified host profiles, accurate listing specifications, direct host communication, and transparent pricing.

## Complete Platform Site Graph

### 1. Residential Leases & Room Rentals (Rent)
- `/rent`: Residential leasing portal.
- `/rent/family-apartments`: Long-term unfurnished and semi-furnished multi-room flats.
- `/rent/family-houses`: Complete residential villas and independent multi-story homes.
- `/rent/bachelor-seats`: Single beds and partitioned seats with inclusive utilities, Wi-Fi, and meal options.
- `/rent/shared-rooms`: Two-to-three person rooms with verified flatmates.
- `/rent/sublets`: Flexible 1 to 6-month leases for visiting professionals and students.
- `/rent/commercial`: Commercial showrooms, retail street spaces, and serviced office cabins.

### 2. Short-Term Stays & Hospitality (Book)
- `/book`: Global accommodation reservations.
- `/book/hotels`: City center business hotels, luxury 5-star properties, and boutique lifestyle stays.
- `/book/resorts`: Eco-resorts, lakeside retreats, mountain lodges, and beachfront properties.
- `/book/guest-houses`: Family-hosted bed and breakfasts with local culinary experiences.
- `/book/holiday-homes`: Private vacation homes, cottages, and secluded retreats.
- `/book/short-stay`: Fully furnished apartments with dedicated fiber Wi-Fi and work amenities.
- `/book/luxury`: Presidential suites, villas with private pools, and VIP concierge packages.

### 3. Sports & Recreation Venues (Sports)
- `/sports`: Real-time venue booking directory.
- `/sports/turf-booking`: FIFA-standard artificial grass pitches for 5-a-side, 7-a-side soccer and box cricket.
- `/sports/football-grounds`: Full-size 11-a-side natural and hybrid grass pitches.
- `/sports/indoor-sports`: Wooden and synthetic indoor badminton, squash, and basketball courts.
- `/sports/swimming`: Temperature-controlled Olympic and training pools.
- `/sports/tournaments`: Comprehensive venue rental for corporate sports days and competitive leagues.
- `/sports/other-activities`: Recreational tracks and sport facilities.

### 4. Property Acquisition (Buy)
- `/buy`: High-level search and property index.
- `/buy/residential`: Gated communities, family duplexes, single-family homes.
- `/buy/commercial`: Office buildings, retail floors, corporate headquarters, bank-ready properties.
- `/buy/apartments`: High-rise condominium penthouses, studio units, multi-bedroom flats.
- `/buy/houses`: Standalone residential houses with private access and land ownership.
- `/buy/land`: Demarcated residential plots, commercial development zones, agricultural land.
- `/buy/new-developments`: Off-plan projects from reputable developers with milestone updates.

### 5. Corporate, Legal & Public Relations
- `/post-listing`: Step-by-step listing wizard for property owners, hotel operators, and turf managers.
- `/about`: Company mission, unified ecosystem vision, and core values.
- `/trust`: Trust standards, host guidelines, and safety practices.
- `/help`: Customer support center and FAQ directory.
- `/terms`: Terms of Service, liability, host obligations, and guest rights.
- `/privacy`: Data privacy and user safety standards.
- `/sitemap`: Interactive human-readable catalog of all marketplace destinations.
- `/sitemap.xml`: XML sitemap structured for web indexing robots.
- `/llms.txt`: Summary format for AI language model scans.

## Integration Protocols & Machine Reading

- Format: UTF-8 Markdown and Schema.org semantic microdata.
- Primary Currency: BDT (Bangladeshi Taka) & USD (United States Dollar).
- Direct connection between verified hosts and users.
